findings.location: Paragraph mentioning specific plants (section: "가시와 엉겅퀴의 우세" / paragraph beginning "아티초크는...")
findings.source_quote: Blessed Thistle, Milk Thistle, Teasel, Raspberry Leaf, and Blackberry roots
findings.suggested_fix: Translate or consistently localize all plant names into Korean (or provide Korean name followed by the original in parentheses). For example: "Blessed Thistle(블레스드 시슬/축복받은 엉겅퀴), Milk Thistle(밀크 시슬/엉겅퀴), Teasel(티슬/도깨비풀), 라즈베리 잎, 블랙베리 뿌리" or provide fully Korean equivalents where conventional. Preserve order and meaning.
findings.translation_quote: 축복받은 엉겅퀴(Blessed Thistle), 밀크 시슬(Milk Thistle), 티슬(Teasel), 라즈베리 잎, 블랙베리 뿌리

findings.location: Paragraph under "질병" (sentence: "God was also faithful in designing people, plants, and animals with a regenerative microbiome (billions of helpful bacteria) and a systemic immune system, which helps us fight off diseases.")
